worker_output.summary: Implemented research system per design/technology/research-formulas.md. Core functions: calculatePlanetRP (Scientists × 1.0 × Lab_Multiplier × Racial_Modifier, with Artifacts +25% and Orion ×4 bonuses), getTechCost (tier cost × galaxy size modifier; AI variant adds difficulty modifier), allocateResearch (splits empire RP across 6 fields with validation), processResearchTurn (accumulates RP, detects completion with overflow carry-over), getMiniaturizedStats (5%/tier reduction capped at 50%). Created technologies.json with tier cost table (1→50, 20→100000), research buildings config (Research Lab +0.5×, Supercomputer +1.0×, Autolab +1.5×, Galactic Cybernet +2.0×, cumulative), racial modifiers (Rats 1.50, Mice 1.15, Guinea Pigs 0.80, etc.), galaxy size modifiers (small 0.75, huge 1.50), difficulty AI modifiers (simple 1.50, impossible 0.50). All 4 worked examples from design doc validated: Hamsters basic RP (30 scientists × 2.5× lab = 75 RP), Rats 5-planet empire (375 RP/turn), Miniaturization (tier 12 vs tier 5 → 13/9.75 size/cost), Tech cost tier 10 large galaxy (7500 RP). Per-field types: ResearchField (6 fields: weapons/propulsion/construction/computers/force_fields/planetology), EmpireFieldResearch (per-field progress/tier/completions), ResearchAllocation (must sum to 100%). No any types, no DOM. All 101 research tests pass; 367 total tests pass. TypeScript compiles clean.
